questions.q: Pointing to a boy, Rekha said, "He is the son of my mother's only brother." How is the boy related to Rekha?
questions.e: Rekha's mother's only brother is her maternal uncle, and his son is her maternal cousin.

questions.q: P is the mother of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S. How is P related to S?
questions.e: Q and R are P's children. R is S's father, so P is S's paternal grandmother.

questions.q: Sunita's mother is the only daughter of Ravi's mother. How is Ravi related to Sunita?
questions.e: Ravi's mother has one daughter, Sunita's mother, so Ravi is her brother. Hence Ravi is Sunita's maternal uncle.

o: S is the grandfather of P
P is the father of S
P is the uncle of S
P is the grandfather of S
questions.e: P is the father of Q. Q is the brother of R, so P is also R's father. R is the mother of S, so P is S's maternal grandfather.

questions.q: A and B are a married couple, A being the husband. C is A's brother. D is C's only son. B is the mother of F. How is D related to B?
questions.e: D is the son of A's brother, so D is A's nephew. B is A's wife, so D is also B's nephew.

questions.q: Pointing to a man in a photograph, Mohan said, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother's mother." How is the man related to Mohan?
questions.e: The only daughter of Mohan's mother's mother is Mohan's own mother. So the man's mother is Mohan's mother, and the man is Mohan's brother.

questions.q: In a code, 'A % B' means A is the daughter of B, 'A & B' means A is the brother of B and 'A $ B' means A is the father of B. If 'M & N % O $ P', how is M related to P?
questions.e: M is N's brother, and N is O's daughter, so M is O's son. O is the father of P, so M and P are children of O. M is P's brother.

questions.q: P is the father of Q. R is the wife of Q. S is the only son of R. T is the sister of S. U is the brother of P. How is U related to S?
questions.e: P is the father of Q. Q and R are the parents of S. So P is S's grandfather, and P's brother U is S's grand uncle.

questions.q: Pointing to a woman, Mahesh said, "Her husband's mother is the only sister of my father's wife." How is the woman related to Mahesh?
questions.e: Mahesh's father's wife is his mother. Her only sister is his maternal aunt, and the woman's husband is the aunt's son. So the woman is the wife of Mahesh's maternal cousin.

questions.q: In a code, 'A # B' means A is the father of B, 'A @ B' means A is the sister of B, and 'A $ B' means A is the wife of B. In 'P # Q @ R $ S # T', how is P related to T?
questions.e: P is the father of Q, and Q is R's sister, so P is R's father. R is S's wife and S is T's father, so R is T's mother. P is the father of T's mother, so P is T's maternal grandfather.
